AGENDA ITEM/PRESENTER | MOTIONS / MAJOR DISCUSSIONS | ACTION TAKEN
CALL TO ORDER | Sabra Matovsky, Committee Vice Chairperson, welcomed everyone and called the L.A. Care and JPA Provider Relations Advisory Committee (PRAC) meetings to order at 9:37 A.M. The meetings were held simultaneously. Ms. Matovsky described the process for public comment. (Committee Chairperson George Greene joined the meeting.) | 
APPROVE MEETING AGENDA | The Agenda for today's meeting was approved. | Approved unanimously by roll call. 10 AYES (Ayoub, Booth, Flores, Greene, Matovsky, Moazzez, Movaghar, Silver, Tyson and Youredjian)
PUBLIC COMMENTS | There was no public comment. | 
APPROVE MEETING MINUTES | The August 21, 2024 meeting minutes were approved as submitted. | Approved unanimously by roll call. 10 AYES

APPROVED
